propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic signed pin per direct child and per normalized prerequisite, ordered lexicographically by role then canonical ID, containing role, canonical ticket ID, and 16-hex material fingerprint.
Plan relation snapshots must preload all ticket states including archived ones, scan inbound block relations over the full map to discover all blockers, and collapse duplicate edges within each role.

Missing, unresolvable, ambiguous, or malformed targets must raise PlanRelationSnapshotError with an exact reason enum before any LLM evaluation, emitting an unsigned INDETERMINATE ERROR record with structured fields and no traceback.

The tracker_head_sha() function must verify a clean git state after ensure_fresh using status --porcelain and ls-files -u, then capture the 40-hex HEAD, mapping all git/IO/subprocess failures to store-read-failure.
Legacy manifests without pins must authenticate their complete stored bytes while ignoring pin lines for field interpretation, preserving pre-feature reader compatibility.
Ordinary sign, progressive refresh, and re-sign flows must all call collect_plan_relation_snapshot and include the complete current pin set in every new attestation.
